author: Monskie
_unlockAtNote: Fixed Manila time (PHT, UTC+8). The +08:00 offset makes this an absolute instant, so it unlocks at 7:00 PM Manila for every viewer regardless of their device timezone. The Philippines does not observe DST, so a fixed offset is safe year-round.

chapters.title: How We Met
chapters.body: Replace this with the story of how you two met. Two or three sentences read best on a phone screen — keep it short, let the photo carry the rest.

chapters.title: Getting Through It Together
chapters.body: Optional chapter — delete this entry if it doesn't feel right. Replace with a hard moment you two got through together, and what it showed you about each other. This one can carry more weight than the others; it's okay if it's shorter or heavier in tone.

chapters.title: A Random Tuesday

finale.title: Today
finale.lockedHeadline: One more chapter is still being written.
finale.letterBody:
Replace this with your anniversary letter to Camille — this is the emotional peak of the whole story, so take your time writing it.

Blank lines become paragraph breaks, so you can write as many paragraphs as you want. It can be as long as you like; this is the one chapter where more text is fine.

media.alt: Placeholder — replace with a recent photo of you two

_mediaNote: Each chapter's media[] holds photos and videos together. The file extension decides how it renders (.mp4/.mov/.m4v/.webm/.ogv become video players). Paths are relative to content/, so they start with photos/.
